_comment: SHARED SITE CHROME (English). English mirror of site.ar.json — same keys, English values. Used by navbar.njk and footer.njk for every migrated page's nav/footer/social links. 'nav' was restructured in Phase 3 (2026-08-11) from a flat list of 16 links into grouped dropdowns, per the user's exact spec — see navbar.njk for how 'type' (link/dropdown/button) is rendered. Each entry's 'key' (top-level OR nested inside a dropdown's 'items') is what a page's navActive value matches against, same as before. REPOSITIONING (2026-09-16): Taqathon 2026's hackathon was postponed and the site now centers on a remote workshop series under the same name. Per explicit instruction, hidden pages are NOT deleted — their templates and copy files are untouched, they're just no longer reachable from 'nav' below (a direct URL still works). Hidden this round: Tracks, Contract, Submissions, Rules & Resources, Judges & Mentors, Community, and the standalone Registration page/button — Submission Guidelines and Newsletter were already gone before this round. 'schedule' (renamed 'Workshops' from 'Schedule & Workshops') was promoted from the old 'participants' dropdown to a top-level link since it's now the site's primary destination after Home. 'contact' dropped from a 2-item ('Support') dropdown to a plain link once FAQ moved in with About (a dropdown holding only one item doesn't make sense as a dropdown) — then FAQ itself was hidden too, in a same-day follow-up (see below).

footer.tagline: Organized by Energy Association for Sustainable Development
